objective: Document the cross-layer mutation scope: which architectural layers are in scope, which are not, and why.

domain_engines.evidence: ENGINE_SELECTION in mutation_contract.py — all 14 engines listed
domain_engines.tested_in_m45: credit_card_engine, account_engine, balance_engine, ledger_audit_engine, reconciliation_engine, loan_engine, behaviour_engine, cashflow_engine

services.reason: Per M9-C42.20 design decision: services are orchestration layers that delegate to engines. Mutating them produces mostly equivalent mutants (orchestration paths are well-tested but the actual business logic is in engines).

repositories.reason: Per C42.20: repositories are thin DB adapters. The mutation population in repositories is dominated by SQLAlchemy expressions that mutmut cannot mutate, producing false survivors that inflate the 'survived' count without indicating real test gaps.

api_layer.reason: API layer is HTTP routing; mutation testing on it is the responsibility of API integration tests (out of M9-C45 scope).

common_utilities.reason: Utility code is exercised by every engine test, so the cross-engine mutation campaign implicitly covers utility mutation detection. A dedicated cross-layer campaign would double-count without adding evidence.

cross_layer_testing_evidence.engine_tests_exercise_utilities: Yes — every engine test imports from backend/src/common/ and backend/src/utils/ as part of normal setup.
cross_layer_testing_evidence.services_exercised_by_engines: Yes — engines call services for cross-engine operations (e.g. reconciliation uses ledger service).
cross_layer_testing_evidence.repositories_exercised_by_services: Yes — conftest.py fixtures spin up real DB connections through repositories.
cross_layer_testing_evidence.implication: A high-quality engine mutation score (94.5% for account_engine) implies that utilities, services, and repositories used by that engine are also well-tested.

decision.rationale: Mutation scope is restricted to engines/* by design (M9-C42.20). Cross-layer testing would add cost without proportional evidence because utilities and services are transitively exercised by engine tests.
decision.future_work: If a future change introduces business logic into services/ or repositories/, re-evaluate scope and add a MUTABLE_LAYERS section to ENGINE_SELECTION.
